threads.body: `GenericPart` now requires a `type` argument, which is a breaking change for any existing callers that previously did `GenericPart(value=...)`. Since this is a shared util package, consider keeping backwards compatibility by defaulting `type` to "generic" (while still allowing providers to pass a specific type).

threads.body: `Compaction.id` and `Compaction.content` are annotated as optional (`... | None`) but currently have no defaults, so callers must always pass them (even when unset). That’s inconsistent with the “optional and omitted” schema goal and makes the type awkward to use.

I feel we should start just using AttributeValue instead of Any in these types, since they ultimately go into a span/log attribute right ?

For `Input/OutputMessage` we just end up completely serializing those (using json.dumps) types into a string.. so I think those Anys are fine to be left as is..
